featured_reviews.name: Simran Jayarao
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dr. Deval is definitely going to become your go-to dentist.

I had a few procedures done with him, including a wisdom tooth removal, a couple of fillings and a root canal for a badly infected tooth. He’s extremely patient and really takes the time to understand the issue before starting anything.

His attention to detail is excellent. What I really appreciated was how he kept following up and checking on me after each session, which made the whole experience feel very reassuring. You can tell he genuinely cares about your dental health, sometimes even more than you do!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had my upper wisdom tooth surgery done by Dr. Deval Amin, and the entire experience was surprisingly smooth, painless and stress-free.
